user.title: Meta Home Link
user.description: Name this link and add your Muse Gadget SDK token from gadgets.muse.ai/settings/sdk-tokens (starts with mgst_). If the Muse Gadget add-on has already paired, its pairing is imported automatically and the credentials step is skipped. Read the Gadget SDK Terms there first.

data.name: Link name (shown to Muse as this home's name)
data.sdk_token: Gadget SDK token (mgst_..., optional until pairing)
data.addon_token: Add-on API token (same as in the add-on options)

credentials.title: Pairing credentials
credentials.description: Paste the whole contents of pairing.json first (required). Below it, paste the whole contents of identity.json from the same folder. With the Muse Gadget add-on this step is skipped: the pairing is imported from /share/muse-gadget/ instead. Both are stored only in this config entry.

devices.title: Devices exposed to Muse
devices.description: Pick exactly which devices Muse may see and control. Anything not picked here is invisible to Muse. You can change this later in Configure.

friendly_names.title: Friendly names
friendly_names.description: The name in each box is what Muse will hear and match on (for example 'Kitchen light'). Leave a box as-is to keep the Home Assistant name, or type a friendlier one. Clear a box to fall back to the Home Assistant name.

error.sdk_token_invalid: That does not look like an SDK token - it starts with mgst_
error.credentials_incomplete: The JSON needs both access_token and refresh_token
error.identity_invalid: That identity.json does not contain a valid mac

init.title: Devices exposed to Muse
init.description: Pick exactly which devices Muse may see and control. Anything not picked here is invisible to Muse.

friendly_names.title: Friendly names
friendly_names.description: The name in each box is what Muse will hear and match on (for example 'Kitchen light'). Leave a box as-is to keep the Home Assistant name, or type a friendlier one.

send_message.name: Send message to Muse
send_message.description: Send one chat turn to Muse through the Muse Gadget add-on and fire a meta_home_link_chat_reply event with the reply.

message.name: Message
message.description: The message to send to Muse.
